title: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an XML… (CVE-2026-80270)
description: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition versions prior to 5.36.00.16 contain an XML Injection vulnerability. This flaw allows an attacker with local access to potentially access or manipulate data without authorization. The vulnerability is identified as CWE-91 and has a medium severity with a CVSS score of 5.1. No patch information is provided in the input data.
